text.en: Several clients praise the front desk and boarding staff for being polite, attentive, and helpful when answering phone inquiries and managing pet stays. However, multiple reviewers express dissatisfaction, pointing out unhelpful communication regarding boarding billing glitches and perceived lapses in animal attentiveness.

Most pet parents report that their dogs and cats returned from daycare and boarding clean, happy, and well cared for, even after extended two-week stays. Conversely, one pet parent felt uncomfortable with staff supervision and noticed their dog seemed reluctant to stay, leading to a mixed perception of pet handling.

title.en: Informative check-in calls and billing issues

text.en: Pet owners appreciate receiving regular phone updates and reassuring reports when checking on their boarding animals during long trips. On the other hand, a reviewer complained about disputed discount promises and computer system issues at checkout, indicating occasional communication friction.

q.en: Can owners call to check on their boarding pets?

a.en: Yes, clients report that staff readily answer calls and provide detailed updates on how their pets are doing.

q.en: What services are offered at this location?

a.en: Reviewers mention using overnight pet boarding, dog daycare, and professional grooming services.

q.en: How do clients view boarding pricing?

a.en: Pricing is seen as premium, and one reviewer reported frustration over checkout system glitches affecting promised discounts.
